description: Explain an existing Autoview command / alert message in plain English: what the engine will actually do with it on the named exchange (side, size, order type, price, brackets, account, dry run), plus caveats where that exchange quietly downgrades or ignores a key (for example t=post sent as a plain limit) or rejects it outright, each caveat naming the code it was read from. Accepts the classic key=value form (several lines, | or & legs included) or a one-line v3 call like buy(BTCUSD, 0.1, -1%). Returns { explanation: string, lines: [{ line, text, caveats: [{ text, ... }] }] } or { error }. Read-only: it parses text only, never reads an account, a key, or sends anything. Describes, never recommends. No token, no account: works for a guest. To see a simulated fill beside the explanation, use sandbox_run.

command.description: the alert message / command string to explain, e.g. e=kraken s=BTCUSD b=buy q=0.1 p=-1% t=post

exchange.description: exchange id (any spelling) to explain against when a line carries no e=

token.description: not needed: explain_command reads no account data and ignores any token sent

name: explain_command
